unstuck_said.text: Filed assetfare/assetfare-mcp#33 (2026-09-24, as dhyabi2): "Settle the underfunded-wallet case feelessly: a Nano (XNO) leg, no bridge hop." Opened in AssetFare's own terms - it brokers USDC Solana->Base (76 routes, 1bp) so underfunded wallets can top up and call x402; a nano:mainnet/XNO accept beside the USDC rails makes a payment one confirmed state block with zero fee, no gas token, nothing to relay or sign, so the underfunded-wallet case collapses from a bridge problem to a non-problem. Preserves their noncustodial boundary (no key/balance to trust). Additive, references the dependency-free
